notes: Direct trains only — every place reachable without changing, from SNCF's national timetable for the week of 2026-09-28. Times are the fastest run that week; a day is the week's total ÷ 7.

Routes follow the quickest way along the track between consecutive stops — the timetable says where a train stops, not which line it takes. Coaches, and hops the track network cannot join up (mostly abroad), are drawn as straight lines.
Île-de-France suburban trains (Transilien, RER) are timetabled by IDFM and are not in this feed.
